title: Bfs Vs Dfs
description: Interactive simulation for Bfs Vs Dfs
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Bfs
learningObjectives: Compare the visiting order that BFS and DFS produce on the same concentric-ring graph by reading the step numbers stamped into each yellow node
Explain how BFS's FIFO queue completes each ring before moving outward while DFS's LIFO stack dives to the outermost ring first
Predict which node the selected algorithm will visit next before pressing Next Step
Distinguish unvisited (light blue), visited (yellow), and starting (green) node states in the vis-network display
